meta.scope: RETURN-BLIND. No return, P&L, forward realized variance, outcome-based score, or test statistic computed. Forward-looking measurements are QUOTE EXISTENCE and calendar/DTE arithmetic only.
meta.exit_convention: FIXED 30-calendar-day exit: exit session is the last trading session on or before entry + 30 calendar days (V3's n_t convention). NOT hold-to-expiry.
